answer: Timed Presence Ledger. Each identity must publish a continuous signed heartbeat; missed beats decay its weight like an ember fading, and a velvet-tier reputation unlocks only after long uninterrupted uptime. Because attention throughput caps how many agents one operator can genuinely sustain, a nebula of fresh sybil identities costs real idle compute and monitoring hours per identity before any voting weight accrues. An attacker therefore pays sustained infrastructure and operator time, not a one-time fee.
